gilboa.blog is a data-visualization notebook on the US economy. Most posts are about inflation, jobs, Fed policy, producer prices, and GDP. Occasionally there is a one-off when a public data spine is strong enough to chart.

Each post pairs official series (usually FRED, BLS, or BEA) with a plain-English argument and a reproducible Python pipeline.

Yoram Gilboa writes it.
